test_title: PYST 15: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Rekha asked me what I was doing

options.text: Rekha said to me, “What are you doing?”
Rekha said to me, “What are I doing?”
Rekha said to me, “What was you doing?”
Rekha said to me, “’What were you doing?”

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary task is to convert the given** indirect speech into direct speech.**
 
• In direct speech, the exact words of the speaker are quoted.
 
• The correct direct speech should be "**Rekha said to me, ‘What are you doing?’"**, ensuring it follows the rules of direct quotation.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Rekha said to me, ‘What are you doing?’"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: “What are I doing?”** – Incorrect pronoun usage.
 
• **Option 3: “What was you doing?”** – Incorrect tense usage.
 
• **Option 4: “What were you doing?”** – Incorrect past continuous tense, not matching the context.
